# GrowGuest — Digital Growth & Direct Booking Pipeline for Hospitality

> GrowGuest is a specialized, founder-led digital marketing consultancy exclusively serving independent hotels, resorts, homestays, and dining venues. We build end-to-end direct booking engines that eliminate 15-25% OTA commissions (MakeMyTrip, Agoda, Booking.com) and rank properties #1 on Google Maps.

## Primary Services

1. **Google Business Profile (GBP) & Map Pack SEO**: Dominating local searches like "hotels near me" or "resort in Nagpur", optimizing map categories, geotagging room photos, removing duplicate spam listings, and acquiring 5-star Google reviews.
2. **Direct Booking Website Conversion Fixes**: Designing sub-1.5s mobile speed direct booking websites that turn lookers into direct guests without middleman fees.
3. **Hospitality Local & Technical SEO**: Keyword strategy targeting high-intent traveler searches ("boutique stay Mukteshwar", "luxury resort Wardha Road").
4. **WhatsApp Booking Automation**: Integrating 1-click WhatsApp reservation triggers with automated greeting flows and staff closing scripts.
